items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I remember Dave McRae... Herbie Collins had a band over there, and I think he had about six pieces, five or six. We had more than he did.

ctx.x: don't remember what his name was. Some of them, I can't... Let's see, I can't say how many pieces was in the band. I remember Dave McRae. He was like the straw boss. I think it was about... I don't know how many pieces was in the band. Just about eight, I guess. I think it was eight pieces. Because Herbie Collins had a band over there, and I think he had about six pieces, five or six. We had more than he did.
Okay. Well, we shall call it quits for now, and continue with your Oriental adventures on our next session.
